in_marathi.name: Kandarpa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cupid, God of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kandarpa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kandarpa is the god of love and desire. He is the embodiment of passionate love and is depicted as a young man with the power to make anyone fall in love with him. Kandarpa is also known as Kamadeva and is the son of Lord Indra and his wife, Indrani.
